alternatives.name: Intercity Bus
alternatives.description: Take a coach bus (e.g., FlixBus, OurBus, Trailways) instead of driving or flying
alternatives.notes: Lower emissions than solo driving for 1-2 people; ~0.0666 kg CO2e per passenger-mile vs ~0.30 for a car

alternatives.name: Carpooling / Rideshare
alternatives.description: Share a ride with others traveling to Ithaca
alternatives.notes: Divides vehicle emissions across passengers; effective for groups

alternatives.name: Group Shuttles
alternatives.description: Organized shuttles for campus visits, conferences, or events
alternatives.notes: Contact Cornell Visitor Relations for shuttle options

alternatives.name: Green-Certified Lodging
alternatives.description: Stay at eco-certified hotels or inns with sustainability practices
alternatives.notes: Look for LEED, Green Seal, or Energy Star certifications

alternatives.name: Efficient Hotels & Inns
alternatives.description: Choose hotels with efficient operations and local ownership
alternatives.notes: Locally-owned hotels may have lower operational footprints

alternatives.name: TCAT Bus
alternatives.description: Use Tompkins Consolidated Area Transit for local travel
alternatives.notes: ~0.0666 kg CO2e per passenger-mile; covers downtown, Cornell, and airport

alternatives.name: Walking
alternatives.description: Walk between nearby attractions instead of driving
alternatives.notes: Zero emissions; many attractions are walkable

alternatives.name: Cycling / Bikeshare
alternatives.description: Bike on trails like the Cayuga Waterfront Trail or use bikeshare
alternatives.notes: Zero emissions; Cayuga Waterfront Trail is bike-friendly

alternatives.name: EV Charging
alternatives.description: Use EV charging stations if driving an electric vehicle
alternatives.notes: EV factor ~0.0328 kg CO2e/vehicle-mile vs ~0.30 for gasoline

alternatives.name: Walkable Attractions
alternatives.description: Choose attractions within walking distance of your stay
alternatives.notes: Cluster activities geographically to minimize driving

alternatives.name: Trails Near Bus Routes
alternatives.description: Visit trails and gorges accessible by TCAT
alternatives.notes: Some trailheads are accessible by TCAT routes

alternatives.name: Car-Free Itineraries
alternatives.description: Plan a full visit without needing a car
alternatives.notes: Combines walking, TCAT, and clustered attractions

alternatives.name: Geographically Clustered Attractions
alternatives.description: Group activities by location to minimize back-and-forth driving
alternatives.notes: e.g., Do Cornell campus + Collegetown in one trip
